paper.title_en: Effective-Potential Formulation of Schrödinger-Newton Dynamics and the $m^{11}$ Stiffness Scaling
paper.abstract_en: The Schrödinger-Newton (SN) equation is the foundational model of semiclassical gravity. In this work, we develop a Gaussian variational reduction that makes the intrinsic scale-invariant structure of the SN equation analytically explicit, yielding a compact and accurate one-dimensional effective Hamiltonian. This framework maps the phase-space geometry of the SN dynamics and reveals that the dimensionally required $m^{11}$ stiffness scaling produces a strongly mass-dependent restoring force against wave-packet deformation. Applying this self-gravitational stiffness to levitated optomechanics, we identify a concrete and falsifiable laboratory signature: a mass-dependent, nonlinear upward shift in the mechanical frequency of a trapped nanoparticle.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了薛定谔-牛顿动力学的有效势表述，揭示了质量相关的刚度标度，并为悬浮光力学提供了可验证的预测。内容深入且新颖，符合基础物理研究范畴。
decision.title_zh: 薛定谔-牛顿动力学的有效势表述与$m^{11}$刚度标度
decision.abstract_zh: 薛定谔-牛顿（SN）方程是半经典引力的基础模型。在这项工作中，我们发展了一种高斯变分约化，使得SN方程固有的尺度不变结构在解析上明确，产生了一个紧凑且准确的一维有效哈密顿量。该框架映射了SN动力学的相空间几何，并揭示了维度要求的$m^{11}$刚度标度产生了一种强烈依赖质量的恢复力，对抗波包形变。将此自引力刚度应用于悬浮光力学，我们确定了一个具体且可证伪的实验室特征：被捕获纳米颗粒的机械频率中出现依赖质量的非线性上移。
